Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site plans and building data; robust condition assessments covering major systems and connection to educational outcomes; integrates short- and long-term capital planning (Sections 4, Appendix A).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections with methodology, capacity utilization by site and grade, and links projections to facility actions including new construction and consolidation; considers new housing impacts and adaptive uses (Sections 2.2, 5.2).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications for TK-8 and 9-12; connects facility projects directly to educational goals including 21st Century learning environments, CTE, special education, and technology integration (Sections 3, 7).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: References to outdoor spaces exist (e.g., green spaces, playgrounds), but minimal detail or districtwide data on greening, shade, or environmental benefits; no comprehensive greening strategy or climate resilience framing (Site descriptions in Section 4).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related issues broadly (e.g., air quality, HVAC importance) but lacks detailed climate risk assessment or comprehensive mitigation strategies integrated into planning (No explicit climate risk assessment found).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency strategies such as HVAC upgrades and modernization; references energy resilience goals and some data; mentions alignment with state requirements but lacks comprehensive electrification and resilience plan (Sections 4, 7).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed capital strategy with itemized cost estimates, phased project prioritization, multiple funding sources including bonds, developer fees, and state grants; includes financial sustainability considerations and alignment with educational priorities (Sections 5, 6, 8).
